question: Will the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix have a higher official attendance than the 2025 Singapore Grand Prix (300,641)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the official total weekend attendance figure for the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix, as published by Singapore GP Pte Ltd, is strictly greater than 300,641, with the announcement occurring strictly after 2026-10-02T15:46:45.147Z and at or before 2026-10-13T06:00:00.000Z.
- "No": Wins if the official total weekend attendance figure for the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix, as published by Singapore GP Pte Ltd, is less than or equal to 300,641, with the announcement occurring strictly after 2026-10-02T15:46:45.147Z and at or before 2026-10-13T06:00:00.000Z.

Clarifications:
- The attendance figure used is the official three-day weekend total published by Singapore GP Pte Ltd following the conclusion of the 2026 race weekend; a figure of exactly 300,641 does not constitute a higher attendance and resolves "No".
